Pradesh to relieve him from the Government of Andhra Pradesh so as to enable him to be
repatriated back to his present department. 6. Aggrieved by the suspension order in G.O.RT.NO.2814 dated 12.12.2019, the petitioner filed an
application before the Central Administrative Tribunal, Hyderabad and on 16.12.2019 the Tribunal
was pleased to suspend the order of the suspension. Having came to know that the petitioner was
approaching the Central Administrative Tribunal against the order in G.O.RT.No.2814, dated
12.12.2019, the State of Andhra Pradesh, with a malafide intention, got filed a complaint on
